currencyRates.title: Currency Rates
currencyRates.description: Configure how currency exchange rates are managed
currencyRates.autoUpdateDescription: When enabled, rates are pulled daily from an external API and manual rate editing is disabled.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Control how users sign in to Savvy
authentication.passwordLoginLocked: Add and enable at least one SSO provider before you can turn this off — it keeps the instance from locking everyone out.
authentication.passwordLoginOpen: When off, users can only sign in through SSO. Active sessions stay signed in.
authentication.passwordLoginError: Enable at least one SSO provider before turning off password sign-in.
authentication.jitDescription: Automatically create an account on first SSO sign-in. When off, only existing or linked users can sign in.
authentication.verifiedEmailOn: New SSO sign-ups must arrive with an email the provider has verified.
authentication.verifiedEmailOff: Turn on just-in-time provisioning to enforce this.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change your password. Other devices will be signed out.
password.ssoOnly: This account signs in with SSO and does not use a password.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Sign out anywhere you are not right now
sessions.logoutOthersDescription: Other browsers and devices will need to sign in again. This one stays signed in.
sessions.confirmDescription: Every other session will be revoked. You will stay signed in here.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Require a verification code in addition to your password
twoFactor.authenticatorDescription: Use a TOTP app such as Google Authenticator or Authy to generate sign-in codes.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in without a password using biometrics, a screen lock, or a security key
passkeys.deleteDescription: This passkey will no longer be able to sign in to your account.
passkeys.domainHint: Passkeys require a secure origin and a valid domain. Open the app over HTTPS or via localhost — raw IP addresses are not allowed.
passkeys.addDescription: Give this passkey a name so you can recognize it later, then follow your browser's prompt.
passkeys.namePlaceholder: e.g. MacBook Touch ID, iPhone, YubiKey

recovery.title: Recovery Codes
recovery.description: Single-use codes to access your account if you lose your authenticator
recovery.remaining_one: {{count}} code remaining. Regenerating invalidates the old set.
recovery.remaining_other: {{count}} codes remaining. Regenerating invalidates the old set.
recovery.regenerateDescription: This will invalidate all existing recovery codes. Enter a verification code from your authenticator app to continue.

dialogs.enableDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
dialogs.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm setup.
dialogs.recoveryDescription: Store these codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once.
dialogs.disableDescription: Enter a verification code to disable 2FA. You can use a code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.

providers.title: Identity Providers
providers.description: Configure OIDC and SAML single sign-on
providers.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. "{{name}}" will be permanently removed.
providers.emptyDescription: Let your team sign in with the accounts they already have — Microsoft, Google, GitHub, Okta and any OIDC or SAML provider. Endpoints come pre-filled for the popular ones.
providers.quickSetupDescription: Pick a provider and connect it in seconds — endpoints and scopes are pre-filled for you.
providers.connectionDescription: How Savvy talks to your identity provider
providers.provisioningDescription: What happens when someone signs in through this provider
providers.roleMappingDescription: Assign roles from IdP claims — the first matching rule wins
providers.noRules: No rules yet — everyone gets the default role above.
providers.previewHidden: Hidden — enable to show on login
providers.registerUrls: Register these URLs in your identity provider.

import.title: Import Transactions
import.description: Import transactions from a CSV file
import.readOnlyDescription: You don't have permission to import transactions. Please contact an administrator if you need write access.
import.dropzone: Drop CSV file here or click to browse
import.sampledNote: Large file: validated a sample of {{sampled}} of {{total}} rows. Exact created/skipped counts are reported after the import runs.
import.allSkipped: All transactions were either duplicates or had errors

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Live view of resource usage and storage health
monitoring.resourcesDescription: What the application consumes right now
monitoring.memoryUnavailable: Memory stats unavailable on this host.
monitoring.volumeUnavailable: Volume capacity is unavailable on this host.
monitoring.storageByBucketDescription: What Savvy keeps on the volume
monitoring.nothingStored: Nothing stored on the volume yet.

backups.title: Backups

schemaStatusHelp.current: This backup’s schema matches the running app.
schemaStatusHelp.outdated: This backup is older. Restore will apply pending migrations.
schemaStatusHelp.newer: This backup was made with a newer app and cannot be restored here.
schemaStatusHelp.unknown: Could not determine this backup’s schema.

backups.empty: No backups yet. Create your first backup to get started.
backups.createDescription: Create a new backup of the current database.
backups.restoreDescription: This will replace all current data with the backup from {{date}}. This action cannot be undone.
backups.restoreNewerDescription: This backup is from a newer version of the app. Restore it on that version, or upgrade Savvy first.
backups.restoreMigrationsDescription_one: This backup is {{count}} migration behind. Savvy will apply it after restore — otherwise the app will not run. The backup file is not changed.
backups.restoreMigrationsDescription_other: This backup is {{count}} migrations behind. Savvy will apply them after restore — otherwise the app will not run. The backup file is not changed.
backups.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete the backup from {{date}}.
